root_idea.summary: The root centers on adorning, embellishing, and giving something an attractive outward form, especially through ornamentation.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence presents gold as a primary ornamental material, extending to decoration and the displayed beauty of the earth, and figuratively to speech beautified through deception.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The canonical Quranic noun is displayed under the normalized citation form زُخْرُف.

senses.definition: Gold, especially gold used as an ornamental material or in an adorned structure.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic contexts for gold associated with an ornamented house and for gold ornaments.

senses.definition: Ornament, decoration, or embellished beauty, including the displayed adornment and perfected appearance of the earth and its vegetation.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used of the earth’s visible adornment and of decorative ornamentation; the sense concerns embellished appearance rather than necessarily the gold material itself.

senses.definition: The fair or embellished appearance of speech, especially speech made attractive through falsehood or deceptive ornament.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ, referring to speech whose attractive presentation conceals or promotes falsehood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adorning, ornamenting, decorating, embellishing, or completing a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun use associated with زَخْرَفَ, including the adornment of a house or chamber.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arranging or putting speech into proper form; also embellishing, falsifying, or adulterating speech, often through lies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A speech-related construction distinct from the physical adornment of an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adorn, ornament, decorate, or embellish oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reflexive or self-directed use of the derived verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Furniture or utensils of a house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use reported for household or tent equipment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lines or streaks visible on the surface of water.
Ships, especially ornamented or decorated ships, or the decorative fittings of ships.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Plural lexical use with variation in whether the term denotes the vessels themselves or their ornamentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small flying insect with four legs that moves or flies upon water.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive-participial adjective describing something given an ornamental finish.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers physical adornment and the speech-related uses of the derived verbal noun.
Covers self-adornment by the derived verb.
Covers the gold sense, including its Quran-attested use.
Covers ornamentation and the specialized household-equipment use; the plant-adornment interpretation is included in the Quranic sense.
Covers embellished or varnished speech and its Quran-attested deceptive use.
Covers the plural term for streaks on water.
Covers the zoological use for small insects on water.
Covers the passive-participial adjective for something adorned.

cautions: Lane’s historical Quran citation notation is retained only as lexical evidence; the modern verse keys and word locations used here come from QAC and the supplied Quran-focused evidence.
The derived verbs and participle in the Classical Arabic section are not additional Quranic form groups; the supplied QAC form group is the noun زُخْرُف.
